dict.string: Displays Spotify Home with compact two-column shortcuts, six artwork columns and a teal and blue backdrop. Titles and subtitles come from Spotify. Open a shelf once to fill in details supplied on its full list. Press and hold a shortcut to open its section.

Uses the native four CarPlay tab buttons to show text-only tabs inside a compact rounded pill with a moving selection capsule. The independent Now Playing button, native tab actions and touch targets remain unchanged. Off by default and independently reversible; does not require Home Styling.
Tap a shortcut or cover to select it. Tap a shelf heading to open the full list. Home Styling and Pill Navigation have separate switches that apply live.

Read-only view hierarchy and layout measurements from CarPlayTemplateUIHost. No song names, messages, contacts, cover images or playlist contents are captured. The automatic report switch is off by default and takes effect when the template host next launches.

The report is saved inside the CarPlayTemplateUIHost process cache or temporary directory, not in shared Documents. Capture while Spotify is open in WinPlay, then locate CarPlay26-Spotify-TemplateUIHost.txt using SSH. Capturing again replaces the previous report.
